more.relayoutConfirm: All pages will be laid out anew. Changes you made in the Fotobuch program will be lost. Continue?
err.title: That didn't work
books.title: Your photo books
books.lead: Carry on where you left off – or turn a folder full of photos into a new book.
books.leadEmpty: Choose a folder with photos – autobook turns it into a photo book.
books.newSub: You choose a folder – autobook does the rest.
books.tip: Tip: autobook recognises folders like “Favourites” and file names starting with “+” as your favourite photos.
books.noAi: Without an OpenAI key autobook chooses the photos without AI.
new.title: Which photos should go into the book?
new.lead: Choose the folder with the photos of your holiday or celebration. Everything in its subfolders is included.
new.onlyPhotosHere: The photos are right in this folder. Just use this folder.
new.emptyFolder: There are no photos in this folder.
wishes.title: What should your book be like?
wishes.lead: A few questions. The suggestions usually fit already – and everything can be changed later.
wishes.notScanned: The photos of this book have not been looked at yet.
wishes.found: This is what we found in “{name}”

wishes.dups.one: near-identical shot – only the best goes in
wishes.dups.other: near-identical shots – only the best of each goes in

wishes.marksToggle: Which marks count? View and change
wishes.format: What shape should the book have?
wishes.thickness: How thick should the book be?
wishes.fewPhotos: There are not enough photos for more pages. The printer needs at least {n} pages – autobook then gives the photos more room.
wishes.useAi: The AI chooses and writes the titles
wishes.noKey: Without an OpenAI key autobook chooses without AI.
wishes.tailor: Let the AI tailor the questions
wishes.tailoring: The AI is thinking of fitting questions …

wishes.aiNote.one: autobook shows small copies of your photos – without locations – to an online service (AI), which finds the best moments and writes the titles. It takes about a minute and costs {cost}.
wishes.aiNote.other: autobook shows small copies of your photos – without locations – to an online service (AI), which finds the best moments and writes the titles. It takes about {n} minutes and costs {cost}.

wishes.offlineNote: autobook chooses without the online service. That's quick, but it matches your taste less well.
wishes.fewPages: The printer needs at least {min} pages. With so few photos every photo gets its own page, and a few pages stay blank at the end – “As complete as possible” or more photos fill them.
wishes.replaces: Your current selection will be replaced (it stays in the history).
wishes.replaceConfirm: Your current selection will be replaced by a new one. Continue?
wishes.withAi: Use the online service (AI) after all
printer.where: Where will you have it printed?
making.title: Your book is being made
making.titleScan: autobook is looking at your photos
making.lead: autobook looks at your photos and picks the best moments.
making.leadScan: Date, place, sharpness and near-identical shots – then we carry on.
making.leave: You can close this window. autobook keeps working, and when you come back you continue here.

sel.stats.one: 1 photo · {c} · about {p} pages · click a photo to see it large
sel.stats.other: {n} photos · {c} · about {p} pages · click a photo to see it large

sel.coverLead: Like another one better? One click is enough.
sel.openerSub: a full page before the chapter
sel.noOpener: The chapter starts with a page with just its title.
sel.emptyChapter: There are no photos left in this chapter. Add one below.
key.title: OpenAI key
key.lead: With your own key the AI picks the best photos and writes the titles; a book usually costs a few cents. You get a key from OpenAI under “API keys”:
key.label: Your key (starts with sk-)
key.isSet: A key is saved on this computer (safely, in its password store).
key.notSet: No key yet: autobook works without AI.
key.fromEnv: The key comes from the OPENAI_API_KEY setting of this computer.
key.savedUnchecked: Saved. It could not be checked just now (no internet?); autobook will try it when it needs it.
key.invalid: OpenAI does not know this key. Please copy it again.
key.badFormat: That does not look like an OpenAI key (it starts with sk-).
key.removeConfirm: Remove the key from this computer? autobook then works without AI.
update.busy: autobook is working right now – update when it is done.
update.failed: The update did not work this time. Try again later.
update.restarting: autobook restarts with the new version …
move.done: Photo moved – the pages are laid out again
move.auto: Let autobook arrange this chapter's pages
move.autoDone: autobook arranges this chapter's pages again
move.otherChapter: A photo can only go onto a photo page of its own chapter
layout.pageDone: The photo gets a page to itself
layout.spreadDone: The photo runs across both pages
layout.spreadHint: In an ordinary binding the middle disappears a little into the fold; a layflat binding shows panoramas best.
layout.normalDone: The photo is back among the others
browse.title: Photos from these days
browse.none: There are no more photos here.
count.label: Photos in the book
count.chapterMore: One more photo in this chapter
count.chapterFewer: One photo fewer in this chapter
count.auto: Fit the photo count to the pages
count.autoWhy: If the book is too thin for the printer, photos are added instead of blank pages.
count.autoOn: The photo count now follows the pages
count.autoOff: The photo count stays as it is

count.filled.one: 1 photo added so that no page stays blank
count.filled.other: {n} photos added so that no page stays blank

act.menu: What do you want to do with this photo?
done.title: Title changed
done.removed: Photo taken out of the book
done.openerBack: The chapter photo is a normal photo again
lb.label: Photo, large
lb.coverSub: on the front of the book
lb.openerBack: Normal photo in the chapter again
lb.openerBackSub: the chapter then starts with just its title
lb.noSiblings: There is no other shot of this moment.
book.title: This is your book

book.lead.one: 1 page. Click a photo to change it – the pages rearrange themselves afterwards.
book.lead.other: {n} pages. Click a photo to change it – the pages rearrange themselves afterwards.

book.layingLead: autobook arranges the photos on the pages. This usually takes less than a minute, a little longer for big books.
book.failed: The pages could not be laid out
book.conflict: Something was changed in the Fotobuch program
book.conflictLead: The chapters no longer match the pages that were edited in the Fotobuch program. autobook can lay out all pages anew – the changes made there will be lost.

book.blanks.one: There is 1 blank page at the end because the printer needs more pages. Add photos to fill it.
book.blanks.other: There are {n} blank pages at the end because the printer needs more pages. Add photos to fill them.

crop.hint: Drag the photo to choose what is cut away
crop.done: New cut – the page is drawn again
design.frameDone: New frame – the pages are laid out again
design.pageColourDone: This page has its own colour now
design.likeBookDone: The page has the book's colour again
print.makingLead: In full resolution, the way the printer needs it. autobook checks it right afterwards.
print.failed: The print file could not be made
print.almost: Almost ready – one thing doesn't fit yet
print.pagesFew: Only {n} pages – the printer needs at least {min}
print.pagesMany: {n} pages – the printer allows at most {max}
print.sharp: All photos are sharp enough for print
print.sharpSub: Including the full-page chapter photos (at least {ppi} ppi).

print.soft.one: One photo is a little soft for its size
print.soft.other: Some photos are a little soft for their size

print.softDo: Make them smaller in the book or take another shot.
print.formatSub: With a margin for trimming, the way printers need it.
print.coverSub: The spine grows with the number of pages. Check its width in your printer's calculator.
print.how1Sub: At your printer: hardcover, {format} {w} × {h} cm, {n} pages.
print.how3Sub: That way you see colours and paper before you order more.
print.coverTypedSub: Exactly the size you typed in from the cover calculator.
print.coverMismatch: The file does not have the size you typed in. Check the sizes below.
print.coverMissing: The cover's sizes are still missing
print.coverMissingSub: Type them in below – the printer's cover calculator tells you what they are.
print.fileTooLarge: The inner pages are too big at {mb} MB – {max} MB allowed
print.fileTooLargeDo: Take out some photos or split the trip into two books.
print.epubli1Sub: On epubli.de, “Buch drucken”: {format} ({w} × {h} cm), {binding}, colour, {n} pages. For photos, paper of 170 g or more is best.
print.epubli4: Check the preview, order one copy first
print.epubli4Sub: Leaf through epubli's preview once. A single book shows you colours and paper before you order more.
print.printerLead: With the same page size, your pages stay as they are.
print.printerSame: Same page size: your pages stay, only the print files are made again.
print.printerNew: Another page size: autobook lays the pages out anew. Your photos and chapters stay.
cover.title: Cover for {printer}
cover.lead: How big the cover must be depends on binding, paper and page count. The printer works it out for you.
cover.calcSub: Choose {format}, your binding, your paper and {n} pages there.
cover.typeSub: As the calculator shows them, in millimetres. autobook then makes the cover exactly that size.
cover.widthHint: Back, spine and front, margin included
cover.marginHint: Cut off or folded around the board. If the calculator shows another value, use its value.
cover.bad: These sizes do not fit the book: without margin and spine the cover needs about {w} × {h} cm.
gold.title: Favourites test
gold.lead: Mark the photos you would choose yourself. This shows how well the AI matches your taste (autobook eval). Photos in “Favourites” folders and with “+” count already.
